tagline.en_US: Create a community question-and-answer site with a single application and built-in SQLite storage.

description.en_US: Apache Answer is an open-source question-and-answer platform designed for teams and communities of all sizes. It serves as an interactive space where users can post questions, share answers, and collaborate. The software supports expansion through a plugin architecture to tailor its capabilities as a community forum, support hub, or knowledge base.
